steps.en: Install the CLI without RAR support
steps.zh: 安装默认不含 RAR 的命令行工具

steps.en: Supply a replaceable archive and request its space plan
steps.zh: 提供可重新获取的压缩包，查看空间计划

steps.en: Estimate peak free-space demand without changing the archive
steps.zh: 不修改原包，估算空闲空间峰值需求

steps.en: Start extraction and approve progressive input removal
steps.zh: 开始解压，确认允许逐步删除输入

steps.en: Write and flush output, record progress, then reclaim input bytes
steps.zh: 写出并刷盘，记录进度，再回收输入空间

steps.en: Finish with extracted files and remove the consumed archive
steps.zh: 留下提取的文件，删除已消耗的原包

value.en: Unpack on the same disk without keeping the entire input beside the entire output
value.zh: 同盘解压，不必让完整输入和完整输出同时占盘
